At r=2 f-vector (18,81,108,18); independently verified 99 matched pairs, 558 oriented Hasse covers acyclic, only one vertex and 26 2-cells. The distance-four relation is six disjoint K3 on triples (0,10,14),(1,11,15),(2,6,16),(3,7,17),(4,8,12),(5,9,13). The r=3 clique complex equals Ind(6 K3) = join of six three-point sets, hence wedge of 2^6=64 S5. At r=4 the complex is full.
